attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"America's national parks and monuments, public lands, and marine protected areas are treasures that should be held in trust for future generations.", "claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect America's national parks and monuments, public lands, and marine protected areas.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will preserve America's unspoiled wildernesses for hunting, fishing, hiking, and camping by codifying the roadless rule.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will grow America's outdoor recreation economy, which supports millions of jobs in rural areas.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will immediately reverse the Trump Administration's harmful rollbacks of protections for national monuments like Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument and Northeast Canyons and Seamounts Marine National Monument.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support banning new oil and gas permitting on public lands and waters.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support modifying royalties to account for climate costs.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support establishing targeted programs to enhance reforestation and develop renewables on federal lands and waters.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will take action to protect wildernesses and waters.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will require full, rigorous, and transparent scientific and environmental reviews of any proposed mining projects near national treasures.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
